+        pos = match.end()

+        self.tokens = tokens
+        self.pos = 0
+
+    def _peek(self):
+        return self.tokens[self.pos] if self.pos < len(self.tokens) else None
+
+    def _advance(self):
+        token = self._peek()
+        self.pos += 1
+        return token

+        value = self._expr()
+        if self._peek() is not None:
+            raise ValueError(f"unexpected token {self._peek()!r}")
+        return value

+    def _expr(self):
+        value = self._term()
+        while self._peek() in ("+", "-"):
+            op = self._advance()
+            right = self._term()

+            return -self._factor()
